info.title: Diesel-to-Solar Hybrid Feasibility API
info.description:
Lender-grade pre-feasibility for replacing diesel generators with solar+BESS hybrid systems across 10 African C&I markets.

**Engineering standards**: ISO 8528-1:2005 | NREL ATB 2024 | HOMER dispatch | PNNL-33283 LCOS | PVGIS-SARAH3 | IFC DSCR | Verra VCS carbon credits.

**v3.0 additions**: GPS→PVGIS irradiance lookup | PPA/EaaS model | DSCR covenant table | 3-scenario analysis | IFC PS1 E&S checklist | Break-even & P90 fields.

**Countries**: Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ghana, Egypt, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Zambia, Senegal, Morocco.

**Sectors**: Manufacturing, Commercial Office, Retail, Cold Chain, Telecoms, Hospital, Hotel, Agro-processing.

Every output equation is cited to its primary engineering source.

post.summary: Quick pre-feasibility with sensitivity and DSCR snapshot
post.description:
Diesel-to-solar pre-feasibility for a single site. **Free plan.**

Returns a complete engineering and financial model including:
- All-in diesel cost (ISO 8528-1:2005 fuel consumption model)
- PV and BESS sizing (NREL ATB 2024 CAPEX; PVGIS-SARAH2 yield)
- Merit-order dispatch: solar → BESS → generator
- NPV, IRR, simple payback (25-year model, 3%/yr diesel escalation)
- DSCR snapshot — lender bankability against IFC 1.30 threshold
- Carbon credit estimate (Verra VCS VM0038)
- FX risk level and IRR downside under currency stress
- Sensitivity table: diesel ±20%/+40%, CAPEX ±10/20%, NPV at 8/10/12/15%
- Generator wet-stacking health check (ISO 8528-1; Cummins 2002)
- Thermal derating — ambient temperature correction on PV yield
- Land area estimate (rooftop and ground-mount)

25-year cashflow schedule available on Pro plan via `/analyse/full`.

post.summary: Full lender-grade model — DSCR, carbon, FX, cashflows, SOH curve
post.description:
Full lender-grade engineering and financial model. **Pro plan required.**

Includes everything in `/analyse/quick` plus:
- Complete 25-year annual cashflow schedule
- Debt structuring: DSCR for each year over loan tenor, lender pass/fail
- Carbon credit revenue (Verra VCS or Gold Standard — your choice)
- FX risk level and IRR downside under currency stress
- BESS State-of-Health degradation curve (phased fade to 80% SOH)
- Full sensitivity matrix
- Custom irradiance override — use your measured site data
- Productive loss quantification from grid downtime (requires revenue/hr input)
- Configurable: discount rate, project life, debt terms, carbon standard

post.summary: Screen up to 30 sites — fleet and portfolio analysis
post.description:
Batch analysis for up to 30 sites in a single call. **Pro plan required.**

Returns per-site results ranked by IRR, plus portfolio totals:
- Total CAPEX, annual savings, CO2 avoided, carbon credit revenue
- DSCR lender pass/fail count across the portfolio
- Sites grouped by viability rating (excellent / strong / viable / marginal)

Typical use cases: tower company fleet screening; EPC pipeline quoting;
DFI grant shortlist ranking; multi-site corporate energy review.

post.summary: Structured lender package — all sections, bankable format
post.description:
Structured lender package — bankable pre-feasibility report format. **Pro plan required.**

Returns a JSON object organised as a complete bankable feasibility report:
- Section 1: Executive summary — headline KPIs, viability rating
- Section 2: Country context — resource, grid, diesel, tax incentives
- Section 3: Technical design — PV, BESS, dispatch, land, thermal derating
- Section 4: Financial model — NPV, IRR, LCOE, 25-year cashflow schedule
- Section 5: Debt structuring — DSCR per year, lender pass/fail, terms
- Section 6: Risk analysis — sensitivity table, FX risk, generator health
- Section 7: Carbon and ESG — CO2 savings, carbon credit pathway, SDG flags
- Section 8: Engineering sources — all primary citations

Use your PDF generation layer to convert this output into a branded client deliverable.
See `/reference/methodology` for full calculation methodology.

post.summary: Screen all 8 sectors for one country — instant market map
post.description:
Screen all 8 sector load profiles for a single country in one call. **Free plan.**

Returns all sectors ranked by IRR — instant market map for that country.

Answers: *"Which sector has the strongest solar economics in Nigeria for my generator fleet size?"*

Results include DSCR lender flag, LCOE vs diesel, CO2, and viability rating per sector.

post.summary: Compare economics across countries for the same load
post.description:
Compare solar hybrid economics across 2–10 countries for the same load profile. **Free plan.**

Returns countries ranked by IRR with key drivers surfaced per country:
diesel price differential, grid reliability, irradiance, incentives, FX risk.

Answers: *"I operate manufacturing facilities across Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya and Ghana —
where should I deploy my solar capital first?"*

post.description:
Fetch site-specific annual irradiance from GPS coordinates using EU JRC PVGIS-SARAH3.

**Free plan.** Results can be passed as `irradiance_override_kwh_m2_yr`
to `/analyse/full` for site-accurate modelling.

CrossBoundary (2021) found that generic country-average datasets overstate
Africa irradiance by up to 20%, causing 1–2% IRR overstatement. This endpoint
eliminates that systematic bias using 15-year Meteosat satellite data at ~3 km resolution.

Source: EU JRC PVGIS v5.3. Huld et al. (2012) Solar Energy 86:1803-1815.

post.summary: PPA vs CAPEX dual-mode analysis — Energy-as-a-Service model
post.description:
Model both PPA/EaaS and CAPEX ownership structures side-by-side. **Pro plan required.**

In PPA/EaaS:
- Developer owns and operates the system (zero CAPEX for customer)
- Customer pays only per kWh consumed at fixed PPA tariff
- Developer earns project IRR from PPA cashflows
- Customer saves vs diesel from day one

Returns: developer IRR, break-even tariff, customer savings vs diesel,
25-year PPA revenue, crossover analysis.

Template: CrossBoundary Energy EaaS — 20-country, $707M portfolio (2025).
Kamoa Copper DRC: 222 MWp + 526 MWh BESS, EaaS structure (April 2025).

Citation: IFC (2023) Mobilizing Private Investment in Clean Energy Africa §3.2.

Run Conservative / Base / Optimistic scenarios side-by-side. **Pro plan required.**

IFC standard stress-test deltas (Sub-Saharan Africa C&I solar):
- Conservative: P90 irradiance (−10%), diesel −20%, CAPEX +15%
- Base:         P50 irradiance, current diesel price, base CAPEX
- Optimistic:   irradiance +5%, diesel +20%, CAPEX −5%

Returns a side-by-side table with IRR, NPV, payback, DSCR, and an
investment decision string: INVEST / PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS / MARGINAL / DO NOT PROCEED.

This is the single output that every investment committee and DFI credit
officer requests. Required for IFC project finance approval packages.

Citation: IRENA (2023) §4.6 risk framework. IFC (2023) §5 stress-test.
Arcadis (2025) sensitivity methodology. IEA PVPS Task 13 (2024) P90 definition.

get.summary: IFC PS1 Environmental & Social pre-screening checklist
get.description:
Generate an IFC Performance Standards pre-screening checklist. **Free plan.**

Returns structured PS1, PS2, PS3, PS6 requirements with:
- IFC project category (A/B/C)
- Equator Principles category
- DFI eligibility list (AfDB SEFA, IFC, Proparco, REPP, KfW DEG, FMO etc.)
- Line-by-line checklist with IFC PS reference and guidance notes

Almost all C&I rooftop and small ground-mount solar in Africa qualifies
as Category B (site-specific, largely reversible impacts).

This checklist is required for any project seeking financing from an
Equator Principles signatory bank or IFC-affiliated DFI.

Citation: IFC Performance Standards on E&S Sustainability (2012).
IFC Project 49569 Botswana Solar Phase 2 ESRS (2024) — Category B precedent.
World Bank Equator Principles IV (2020). AfDB ISS Category 2 (2013).
